## Feature Description
A clear and concise description of the feature or template you'd like to see.

## Use Case
**What problem does this solve?**
Describe the scenario where this feature/template would be useful.

## Proposed Solution
**How should it work?**
Describe how you envision the feature working (template structure, systemd integration, etc.)

## Example
```bash
# Example usage or configuration
monitor-xyz --threshold 90
```

## Alternatives Considered
**What other approaches have you thought about?**
Describe alternative solutions or workarounds you've considered.

## Template Type
- [ ] New Bash template
- [ ] New Python template
- [ ] systemd unit enhancement
- [ ] Documentation improvement
- [ ] Library/function addition
- [ ] Other: (please specify)

## Related Resources
- Links to similar tools/templates
- Relevant documentation
- Example implementations

## Additional Context
Add any other context, screenshots, or examples about the feature request here.
